limitations: One noisy BAAB series on a Windows DX12 CPU adapter; not statistical or cross-platform qualification.
CPU is normalized across 16 logical processors; GUI frame counters are not physical presentation FPS or input latency.
Host activity includes owned application/producer/controller and other processes, not precise external-CPU attribution.
The 200-frame producer is equal and ordered; GUIs may render/coalesce at different rates without proving every intermediate presentation.
Final desktop captures are external and may differ due to caret blink; their raw hashes are retained, not asserted pixel-identical.
Producers are matched byte-identical source/fixtures/dependency manifests, not one shared executable; both independent build hashes remain explicit.
No installed application sessions, credentials or user terminal contents were accessed.
This does not reproduce multi-day aging, establish resource budgets or imply Windows Terminal parity.
